editorialNotes.standard: Unedo helps intermediate Spanish learners bridge the gap between speaking the language and truly understanding it, pairing familiar drills like daily word puzzles with original stories from local journalists in Mexico, Spain, Colombia, and Peru.

advisories: Infrequent/Mild Alcohol, Tobacco, or Drug Use or References

editorialNotes.standard: ElevenReader narrates books, articles, and PDFs in over 30 languages using hundreds of natural, expressive AI voices—including James Dean, Maya Angelou, Michael Caine, and other stars, through partnerships with the celebrities and their estates.

If you’re most productive at 30,000 feet, FocusFlight brings that same distraction-free mindset down to earth by re-creating the calm of Airplane Mode. Choose a destination based on how long you want to focus, then reach new heights of productivity.

editorialNotes.standard: Classic albums, dreamy vacation destinations, must-read books—if you can track it, you can Hypelist it. The app’s robust tools help you catalog your favorites (manually or with a seamless import of screenshots or social media links) and share them with an engaging community.

advisories: Infrequent/Mild Alcohol, Tobacco, or Drug Use or References

editorialNotes.standard: Cosmos aggregates beautiful photographs, all curated and organized by a very discerning community. The app’s sense of endless discovery permeates the elegant design and shines in the small details: Try adding a hex code to your search to find what you’re looking for in a specific hue, or browse Cosmos’ infinity canvas, a full-screen cascade of images that unlocks when you tap the Cosmos icon from the Home tab.

Are you looking for an upcoming hackathon, climate forum, or networking breakfast for founders? Luma, a curated event platform, brings together interesting meetups worldwide, allowing you to connect with like-minded individuals in your area.

Each day, Spark serves up four puzzles around a single theme that build on one another to reveal surprising connections and outrageous facts. It’s a rigorously researched lesson that’s so playful you won’t even notice you’re learning.

With incredible trip planning tools, offline maps, and guides to discover all that national and state parks have to offer, Chimani makes exploring the great outdoors feel a lot less daunting. Handy flags call out any closures, restrictions, or permit requirements too, so you can focus on enjoying your upcoming adventure.

Travel planning just got easier. With interactive maps of Amsterdam’s boutique hotels and Tokyo’s bathhouses; walking tours of Washington, D.C., and Úbeda, Spain; and expert recs for hundreds of cities, Lonely Planet is our go-to for indulging our wanderlust.

editorialNotes.short: Explore famous paintings and learn about the artists.
editorialNotes.standard: Each morning, Daily Art shares a painting, a pastel, an ink drawing, a woodcut, a figurine, or another type of artwork—along with a charming, personal take on what makes it great. By connecting works of art with the world at large, this educational app helped us take a much-needed beat for beauty.

The App Store Award–winning Prêt à Makeup gives you countless ways to experiment with digital makeup and express yourself, using line-drawn faces spanning a range of races and genders, makeup tools, and themed templates running from minimalist to neon-saturated.

editorialNotes.short: Subscribe to watch the season live.
editorialNotes.standard: The official NBA app is your go-to source for all things basketball. Follow your favorite players and teams on and off the court with real-time scores, news, and schedules. Get exclusive behind-the-scenes looks and rim-rattling highlights in Moments, a mobile-friendly vertical scroll of short videos. And when it’s game time, stream out-of-market broadcasts live and on demand with an NBA League Pass subscription.

Even the dark side of the moon gets illuminated on Moonlitt, an elegantly designed tracker for the moon’s phases, trajectory, and major lunar events—from Wolf Moons to total eclipses—so you know what’s worth staying up for.

Sunlitt keeps you one step ahead of the sun, tracking its path, timing golden hour and solar noon, and even mapping shadows cast by surrounding terrain so you always know when to chase the light or take a break in the shade.

editorialNotes.standard: Apple Design Award finalist Harvee is the friendly translator between your Apple Watch data and your actual wellbeing, turning HRV, sleep stats, and stress levels into guidance you can act on.

Sometimes, it can be helpful to receive affirmations in the form of a Neolithic grunt. The Apple Design Award–winning app delivers these daily “grugs,” and each reminder is made even more delightful by the scribbled design.

By partnering with a global network of therapists, Evolve delivers resources to help members of the LGBTQ+ community find self-care support. The app’s meditations and thoughtful questions are invaluable when reflecting on some of life’s biggest topics, like coming out to your loved ones and navigating gender dysphoria.
Co-Star analyzes your birth date and time—down to the minute—to provide in-depth horoscopes, match your compatibility with others, and answer some of life’s biggest questions.

Created using gaming industry tech like 3D modeling and lighting effects, (Not Boring) Weather makes local forecasts delightfully interactive. Fun flourishes such as high-fidelity sound effects, charming animations, and just-noticeable haptic feedback make the weather report anything but boring.

editorialNotes.short: Listen to meditative sounds on Apple Watch.
editorialNotes.standard: Drift off or dial in with BetterSleep—an app that puts you in control of your soundscapes. Mix everything from crackling campfires to morning birds, or explore the app’s library of meditations, sleep tales, breath work exercises, and more.

editorialNotes.short: Listen to meditative sounds on Apple Watch.

This design-forward mindfulness studio taps into a range of modalities to help you find calm, build rituals, and grow in your self-care practices.

editorialNotes.short: Uncover the good and bad about your favorite foods and beauty products.
editorialNotes.standard: Yuka can help you make informed choices about what you eat and use every day. Scan your favorite snacks or beauty products, and the app will break down any additives, irritants, nutritional red flags, and more in seconds so you know exactly what’s going into your body.

Think strategically about strength with Ladder, the weight-training app built on goal-oriented weekly programs and a supportive community of coaches and teams. It also incorporates progressive overload—the practice of lifting slightly heavier each session—to ensure your workouts keep working for you.
Ahead aims to help you improve your closest relationships by investigating emotions, reactions, and triggers that may be holding you back.
Lingokids sets kids up for success in school and beyond with thousands of activities that cleverly disguise education as entertainment.

Master English, French, Spanish, Italian, and German with Addi the ladybug—your AI-powered language sidekick from the App Store Award–winning app EF Hello. Dive into lifelike conversations that make learning feel second nature—perfect for beginners looking to level up.

With the help of pediatric experts and AI, Huckleberry analyzes your child’s habits to determine their natural rhythms so naps, meals, and bedtimes are easier for everyone. Keep track of daily activities such as bottle feeds, breastfeeding or pumping sessions, naps, diaper changes, and more.
Marco Polo lets you share text and video messages with the people you care about most—without worrying about likes or followers.

editorialNotes.short: Snap the label, become an instant wine expert.
editorialNotes.standard: Choosing a bottle of wine doesn’t have to be overwhelming. With the help of your iPhone camera, Vivino turns you into an expert sommelier.
Full of mini-games and puzzles created in collaboration with speech therapists, Speech Blubs gives kids an entertaining way to practice pronouncing words and sounds.

advisories: Infrequent/Mild Alcohol, Tobacco, or Drug Use or References

editorialNotes.short: Discover cult classics, eye-opening docs and hard-to-find dramas.
editorialNotes.standard: Curated by and for true cinephiles, this App Store Award–winning streaming app is one of our favorite ways to discover cult classics and modern masterpieces alike.

Tinybeans saves all of your journal entries and photos of your child in one place—and ensures they can only be seen by trusted friends and family.

editorialNotes.standard: Go beyond tracking your recently visited restaurants—rank them with Beli. The app’s gamified experience makes it fun to organize new haunts (or tried-and-true favorites) and discover the places that blew your friends away.

advisories: Infrequent/Mild Alcohol, Tobacco, or Drug Use or References

editorialNotes.standard: It’s never been easier to find and instantly book the world’s best restaurants and hotels with The Michelin Guide. Filter by cuisine, distinction, price, days open, and more—and save, favorite, or take notes on your last truly memorable meal (for better or worse).

Chilli empowers people to take meaningful action on environmental concerns—all while holding those in power accountable. Use the app to find campaigns related to issues you care about, then sign petitions, send emails, or call lawmakers to add collective pressure that can lead to structural change.

attributes.artistName: Vacation and Travel Planner App LLC
attributes.name: Wanderlog - Travel Planner

editorialNotes.standard: Wanderlog organizes your entire travel plan—flights, stays, and must-see spots—in a sleek (and shareable) itinerary. The app’s community-sourced guides can help you discover hidden gems on your next adventure too.

advisories: Infrequent/Mild Alcohol, Tobacco, or Drug Use or References

editorialNotes.standard: Separate the signals from the noise with Particle, the AI-powered news platform that gives you multiple perspectives and smart summaries on the topics you care about. Each story is pulled from a wide range of reputable sources and is broken down into opposing views, key context, quotes, and podcast clips; you can ask questions directly too.
For serious athletes who thrive outside their comfort zone, The Outsiders delivers personalized performance insights to help anyone go further without overdoing it.

Track important moments (naps, diaper changes, feedings, and more) to get personalized schedule suggestions tailored to your baby’s rhythms. Backed by sleep science and packed with over 30 soothing sounds, Napper helps you build a routine that works for your whole family.

editorialNotes.short: Engage kids with the essential early curriculum in a fun way.
editorialNotes.standard: Join Captain Kidd, Barbie, PJ Masks, and friends in Kiddopia, an exciting world where little ones build new skills through play. Visit Math Whiz Island to practice counting, then hop over to Lingo Land for phonics fun. With so much to explore, every adventure is a chance to learn!

The hassle of managing group newsletters is stripped away with Letterloop, an app that makes it easy to ask (and answer) thoughtful questions or share updates with friends and family. And it’s all delivered to your email inbox on a recurring schedule.

With regular horoscopes, birth chart breakdowns, and more, Chani helps clear up the mystery of the stars. The app not only serves as an accessible entry point for astrology beginners but also includes a breadth of information for experts.

advisories: Infrequent/Mild Alcohol, Tobacco, or Drug Use or References

editorialNotes.standard: Find people who share your vibes with the vibrant friendship and dating app Wink. Break the ice with help from the app’s AI-eyeball companion—or by sending a wacky reaction (sometimes a dancing avocado says it all).

advisories: Infrequent/Mild Alcohol, Tobacco, or Drug Use or References

editorialNotes.standard: Bump takes your maps to a new level. This location sharing app does more than help you keep tabs on your besties—it helps you engage with the world in fresh, delightful ways. Track the percentage of ground you’ve explored in your community, get a live ETA of your friends, and even see (and save) the songs they’re streaming in real time.

ios.subtitle: Map of your people and places

editorialNotes.standard: Giving your pet a scrub-down in real life can be a messy process, but don’t worry: You’ll have plenty of ways to spiff up, dress up, and care for your colorful best pals in Crayola Scribble Scrubbie Pets.

Crayola Create and Play gives children ages 3 to 8 a space to mix hues, play games, and, of course, color and draw using crayons, markers, pencils, paints, and more in just about every shade imaginable.

editorialNotes.short: Always know which card to pay with
editorialNotes.standard: Not sure which credit card will give you the most rewards? CardPointers takes into account where you’re shopping (coffee shop, gas station, airline website) to help you pick the right one for each purchase.

This lightning-fast task manager makes entering even the most complex to-dos unusually easy, whether you type in natural language or rattle off what you need to do with your voice.

editorialNotes.standard: Break down language barriers with this Apple Design Award finalist, which in real time transcribes and translates meetings into more than a dozen languages, including Spanish, Simplified Chinese, and German. As a bonus, Capy’s AI summaries might be more polished than the conversation itself.

Atoms, a tried-and-true system based on James Clear’s Atomic Habits, tracks your behavior over time and encourages you along the way—helping you prioritize small actions to accomplish your biggest dreams.
